_source: OSRS Wiki: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's_Challenges, Transcript:TzHaar-Ket-Rak, JalTok-Jad, Yt-HurKot, TzHaar (castes), TzRek-Jad; ids are cache gamevals. Tiles, timings, healer counts and the messages are from rsprox.net recordings 3886 (rev 235) and 4308, 91, 550, 1754 (rev 227): every challenge's Jads, completions, deaths with and without kills, and leaving by the cave exit.
_infernoChallenge: Challenges 3 and up need TzKal-Zuk defeated at least once (Wiki).
_arena: A private copy of the Inferno arena (region 9043; the cave exit is the arena's, 2269,5325). rsprox: the player lands on 2271,5344 facing south 3 ticks after picking (landing seq quest_lunar_landing_on_face), the screen fading out at the pick and back 6 ticks after; the Jads come 18 ticks after the pick, each challenge's on its own tiles (south-west corner, facing as Direction ids: 0 NW 1 N 2 NE 3 W 4 E 5 SW 6 S 7 SE).

arena._fadeCloseTicks: Calibrated: the cleared overlay is closed 2 ticks after the fade-in (the recordings do not show it).
arena._supports: The Inferno's rocky supports (rocky_support_multi, as Run.Inferno.js places them), taken out of the copy.

_outside: rsprox: out of a challenge (completed, failed or by the cave exit) the player stands on 2544,5111 facing east, before TzHaar-Ket-Rak.
_jadStaggerTicks: Calibrated: each Jad's first attack 3 ticks after the one before, as the Inferno's triple Jads (Wiki: so they can be flicked).
_healers: rsprox: five Yt-HurKot come for each Jad once its health bar is under half, and go when it dies. Wiki Yt-HurKot: they heal 15-24 every 4 ticks in melee distance (Mod Ash). Their spawn tiles round the Jad are calibrated (the recordings scatter them within a few tiles).
_endTicks: rsprox: the completion lines come as the last Jad dies; the player is back outside 5 ticks later and TzHaar-Ket-Rak speaks the tick after.
_ca: Combat Achievements: Wiki TzHaar-Ket-Rak's_Challenges#Combat_Achievements. Seconds are game ticks x 0.6.

messages.enter: You enter the Inferno for TzHaar-Ket-Rak's {ordinal} Challenge.
messages.completionCount: Your completion count for TzHaar-Ket-Rak's {ordinal} Challenge is: <col=ff0000>{count}</col>.
messages.needInferno: You need to complete the Inferno to unlock TzHaar-Ket-Rak's {next} Challenge.
messages.survivedNone: You survived for <col=ff0000>{time}</col> but failed to kill JalTok-Jad{end}
messages.survivedNoneMulti: You survived for <col=ff0000>{time}</col> but failed to kill any JalTok-Jads{end}
messages.notBad: Not bad for a JalYt. Have some TokKul.
messages.reward: TzHaar-Ket-Rak has rewarded you with {amount} TokKul.
messages.noTeleport: You can't teleport out of the challenge.
messages._unverified: noTeleport has no capture behind it; nor do the single-Jad death line ('failed to kill JalTok-Jad before perishing.'), a multi-Jad challenge left by the exit, or leaving with kills - those follow the recorded lines. The partial TokKul for k kills is the k-th challenge's reward: recorded for one kill (80), inferred beyond.
